description: This file defines the AggregateException class in the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, representing an exception thrown when multiple errors occur in promise-related methods.

classes.name: AggregateException
classes.description: An exception class used for aggregating multiple rejection reasons in promise methods like some() or any().

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AggregateException with a message and array of reasons for rejection.
